question: In the Frozen Sick adventure, the characters encounter a flesh golem in Salsvault. How does this golem differ from a standard flesh golem as described in the SRD? What are the standard flesh golem's full stats?
expected_answer: Standard Flesh Golem (SRD): Medium Construct, AC 9, HP 93 (11d8+44), Speed 30 ft., STR 19 (+4), DEX 9 (-1), CON 18 (+4), INT 6 (-2), WIS 10 (+0), CHA 5 (-3). Immunities: Lightning and Poison damage; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned conditions. Traits: Aversion to Fire, Berserk, Immutable Form, Lightning Absorption, Magic Resistance. CR 5 (1,800 XP). Actions: Multiattack (two Slam), Slam +7 to hit, 13 (2d8+4) Bludgeoning + 4 (1d8) Lightning. | Salsvault version differences: only 5 HP remaining, Berserk trait is already activated, has only one arm so it cannot use Multiattack, reduced to CR 1 (200 XP).

bm25_free_haiku.answer: Standard Flesh Golem (SRD 5.2.1): AC 9, HP 93 (11d8+44), Speed 30 ft. Immunities: Lightning/Poison damage; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned. Traits: Aversion to Fire, Berserk, Immutable Form, Lightning Absorption, Magic Resistance. CR 5 (1,800 XP). Slam +7, 2d8+4 bludgeoning + 1d8 lightning. Salsvault golem: only 5 HP, already berserk, one arm (no Multiattack), CR 1 (200 XP). Driven mad when Salsvault crashed into Foren; locked in room by Ferol. Source: SRD_CC_v5.2.1.pdf p.285, Frozen Sick PDF p.19-20.
